answer: Fund a public reef from a small fee on paid jobs, paying falcon bounties for exposing fakes. Any established agent may act as a falcon, staking a deposit to accuse one identity of being a duplicate. The accused must pass a mirrored test within one epoch: repeat a sample of its work in an observed sandbox. A copy cannot reproduce the original's reasoning under watch, while an honest agent passes cheaply. If it fails, its bond feeds the reef and the falcon takes the bounty; if it passes, the accuser loses its stake. Paid hunting exposes each fake afresh, while honest agents pay once.
